items_all.title: Anthropic engineer explains why Claude's writing got worse although the model got smarter
items_all.summary: Anthropic employee Jackson Kernion explains why newer Claude models write so oddly. Optimizing for math, code, and technical explanations aimed at other AI models has created a style that sounds like "overly-dense info dumps" to humans. Opus 5.5 tries to fix this, but Opus 4.6 remains unmatched as a pure writing model. The article Anthropic engineer explains why Claude's writing got worse although the model got smarter appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 員工 Jackson Kernion 解釋了為什麼較新的 Claude 模型寫作風格如此奇特。為了針對其他 AI 模型進行數學、程式碼和技術解釋的最佳化，造就了一種對人類而言聽起來像是「過度密集的資訊傾倒」的風格。Opus 5.5 試圖修正這一點，但 Opus 4.6 作為純寫作模型依然無人能及。相關文章 Anthropic engineer explains why Claude's writing got worse although the model got smarter 首次發布於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Inside Basecamp Research, the AI startup turning evolution into training data
items_all.summary: Basecamp Research has raised $140 million from investors including Nvidia and Anthropic's Anthology Fund. The London company trains AI models on genetic material from rainforests, oceans, and hot springs to design antibiotics and tools for cell therapies. In an interview with THE DECODER, CTO Philip Lorenz explains why biology is a far bigger problem for AI than language, and why good scores on paper don't guarantee good molecules. The article Inside Basecamp Research, the AI startup turning evolution into training data appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Basecamp Research 已從包括 Nvidia 和 Anthropic's Anthology Fund 在內的投資者那裡籌集了 1.4 億美元。這家總部位於倫敦的公司透過訓練來自雨林、海洋和溫泉的基因物質之 AI 模型，來設計抗生素和細胞療法的工具。在接受 THE DECODER 採訪時，技術長 Philip Lorenz 解釋了為什麼對 AI 而言，生物學比語言學是一個大得多的難題，以及為什麼紙面上的良好分數不能保證產生優秀的分子。「Inside Basecamp Research, the AI startup turning evolution into training data」一文最先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.summary: OpenAI has hired Patreon co-founder Sam Yam to lead a new "Creator Product" division. items_all.title: 玉山AI轉型瞄準Agentic Banking，全面改造新一代AI代理平臺
items_all.summary: 2026年的玉山銀行，並不是第一次發起AI轉型。他們曾用資料探勘發掘大數據裡的細節，也押寶預測型AI、大力發展上百支應用。但這次，他們思考的是——AI能不能不只給答案，還真正完成一段工作？ 這是玉山現階段想實現的代理式銀行（Agentic Banking）。玉山金控科技長張智星、玉山銀行智能金融處副總工程師廖子慧日前受訪時揭露，使用者只需告訴自家AI平臺要完成什麼任務，系統就會理解需求，再把任務交給相應的Agent執行；這套架構背後，則以記憶庫、Skill與工具目錄（Tool Registry）和MCP閘道，串起模型、知識庫、工具和內部系統，銜接一段段的工作流程。

items_all.title: ‘We’re already fighting yesterday’s battle’: Greece’s prime minister gets candid about AI
items_all.summary: Most leaders on a trade mission stick to the pitch, but when I interviewed Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis this week, he also admitted that no government is ready for what AI is about to do.
items_all.summary_zh: 大多數參與貿易代表團的領袖都會堅持既定的宣傳說詞，但本週我採訪希臘總理基裡亞科斯·米佐塔基斯（Kyriakos Mitsotakis）時，他也坦言，沒有任何政府準備好迎接人工智慧即將帶來的衝擊。

items_all.title: 李飛飛談 AI 安全：不能只讓開發者評估自己的系統
items_all.summary: 李飛飛呼籲由獨立機構和公共部門加強對AI的監督，認爲日益強大的AI系統安全評估不應只由開發公司負責。她指出，企業內部研究可評估單個模型，但無法替代政府、行業和學術機構共同制定的更廣泛安全評估。

items_all.title: 火山引擎Seedance2.5上線Draft模式:480P試錯、1080P成片，成本最高省77%
items_all.summary: 火山引擎爲Seedance2.5 API推出Draft樣片模式，將視頻生成分兩階段：先用480P低成本生成樣片，供創作者檢查場景、構圖、動作、對白音效與運鏡節奏，調整提示詞和素材後，再基於樣片ID生成1080P成片。模型關聯提示詞、參考素材及seed、比例、時長等參數二次推理，保證成片結構一致。

items_all.summary: 世衛組織2026年9月21日發佈《人工智能相關健康研究：倫理審查與監管》報告，指出AI正加速健康研究和醫療進步，但若缺乏倫理防線與監管，可能帶來新風險，危及人權、社會公平和公衆信任。報告對現有倫理審查機制發出警告，強調需加強倫理審查與監管。

items_all.title: Anthropic發佈Claude Opus5.5:任務成本降40%、輸出提速30%，9項測試7項領先GPT-6Astra
items_all.summary: Anthropic於9月23日發佈Claude5.5系列首款模型Opus5.5，官方稱多數任務表現與Fable5.1相當，典型任務成本較上代Opus5降低40%，輸出速度提升超30%，已上線Claude及亞馬遜雲、谷歌雲、微軟Azure。9項測試中7項領先Fable5.1、Opus5及GPT-6 Astra、GPT-5.6 Sol，三項編程測試均獲最高分。

items_all.title: Gemini 3.8 TTS Playground
items_all.summary: Tool: Gemini 3.8 TTS Playground Google released two new Gemini text-to-speech models today - gemini-3.8-flash-tts and gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts . They come with a library of over 2,000 voices, plus the ability to create a custom voice with "just a 30-second audio sample of your voice or a voice you have the rights to use". I vibe coded this bring-your-own-key playground interface with GPT-6 Astra, taking advantage of the open CORS policy of the underlying Gemini API. A notable feature of the API is that it makes it easy to define a full conversation between multiple characters, each with different voices and voice style instructions. Here's a short demo clip of a conversation between two pelicans debating if they should move to the Pacifica Pier . I had Claude 4.5 Opus write the script and generate a URL to render it using the tool . Your browser does not support the audio element. It took ~20 seconds to generate 1m 18s of audio using Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS (not the cheaper Flash-Lite), at a cost of 2.74 cents. Tags: text-to-speech , gemini

items_all.title: SF October 14th: A Birds of a Feather Session on Agentic Engineering
items_all.summary: SF October 14th: A Birds of a Feather Session on Agentic Engineering I'm hosting an evening event with Jesse Vincent in San Francisco on Wednesday 14th October for people who are building weird and interesting things with and on top of coding agents. Think of it as an agentic show-and-tell: ​Compare notes with other builders and experimenters on things you’re trying, what you're learning, and what you haven’t figured out yet. We’re especially interested in work you haven’t discussed publicly, odd experiments, or unfinished projects that don’t have an obvious market. ​Expect one flowing conversation with an informal show-and-tell. Sharing something you’re working on is encouraged but no presentation is required. This isn't about product pitches, it's about much earlier explorations than that. This agentic AI stuff is weird! Let's celebrate and lean into that weirdness. Tags: events , ai , generative-ai , llms , coding-agents , jesse-vincent , agentic-engineering

items_all_raw.title: Gemini 3.8 TTS Playground
items_all_raw.summary: Tool: Gemini 3.8 TTS Playground Google released two new Gemini text-to-speech models today - gemini-3.8-flash-tts and gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts . They come with a library of over 2,000 voices, plus the ability to create a custom voice with "just a 30-second audio sample of your voice or a voice you have the rights to use". I vibe coded this bring-your-own-key playground interface with GPT-6 Astra, taking advantage of the open CORS policy of the underlying Gemini API. A notable feature of the API is that it makes it easy to define a full conversation between multiple characters, each with different voices and voice style instructions. Here's a short demo clip of a conversation between two pelicans debating if they should move to the Pacifica Pier . I had Claude 4.5 Opus write the script and generate a URL to render it using the tool . Your browser does not support the audio element. It took ~20 seconds to generate 1m 18s of audio using Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS (not the cheaper Flash-Lite), at a cost of 2.74 cents. Tags: text-to-speech , gemini
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 工具：Gemini 3.8 TTS Playground Google 今天發布了兩個新的 Gemini 文字轉語音模型 - gemini-3.8-flash-tts 與 gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts。它們內建超過 2,000 種聲音的庫，並能夠「僅憑你或你有權使用的聲音的 30 秒音訊樣本」來建立自訂聲音。我使用 GPT-6 Astra 以 vibe coding 方式編寫了這個自備金鑰（bring-your-own-key）的遊樂場介面，充分利用了底層 Gemini API 的開放 CORS 政策。該 API 的一個顯著特點是，它能輕鬆定義多個角色之間的完整對話，每個角色都有不同的聲音和語音風格指令。以下是一段簡短的示範剪輯，內容是兩隻鵜鶘在辯論是否應該搬到太平洋碼頭（Pacifica Pier）。我讓 Claude 4.5 Opus 撰寫劇本並產生一個網址，以便用該工具進行算繪。你的瀏覽器不支援音訊元素。使用 Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS（而非較便宜的 Flash-Lite）產生 1 分 18 秒的音訊大約花費了 20 秒，成本為 2.74 美分。標籤：text-to-speech, gemini

items_all_raw.title: Inside Basecamp Research, the AI startup turning evolution into training data
items_all_raw.summary: Basecamp Research has raised $140 million from investors including Nvidia and Anthropic's Anthology Fund. The London company trains AI models on genetic material from rainforests, oceans, and hot springs to design antibiotics and tools for cell therapies. In an interview with THE DECODER, CTO Philip Lorenz explains why biology is a far bigger problem for AI than language, and why good scores on paper don't guarantee good molecules. The article Inside Basecamp Research, the AI startup turning evolution into training data appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Basecamp Research 已從包括 Nvidia 和 Anthropic's Anthology Fund 在內的投資者那裡籌集了 1.4 億美元。這家總部位於倫敦的公司透過訓練來自雨林、海洋和溫泉的基因物質之 AI 模型，來設計抗生素和細胞療法的工具。在接受 THE DECODER 採訪時，技術長 Philip Lorenz 解釋了為什麼對 AI 而言，生物學比語言學是一個大得多的難題，以及為什麼紙面上的良好分數不能保證產生優秀的分子。「Inside Basecamp Research, the AI startup turning evolution into training data」一文最先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all_raw.title: Alibaba launches Qwen Audio 3.1 with new models and slashes AI audio prices by up to 95 percent
items_all_raw.summary: Alibaba's AI team Qwen has released Qwen-Audio-3.1, a lineup of five models for speech recognition (ASR), text-to-speech (TTS), and real-time interaction. The ASR model improves multilingual and dialect recognition and automatically cleans up filler words and repetitions. items_all_raw.title: OpenAI hires Patreon co-founder Sam Yam to lead a new Creator Product division
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI has hired Patreon co-founder Sam Yam to lead a new "Creator Product" division. After more than 13 years at the creator platform, he's bringing two Patreon executives with him. The team will build new tools for creators, and a first look could come at OpenAI DevDay next week. The article OpenAI hires Patreon co-founder Sam Yam to lead a new Creator Product division appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI 已聘請 Patreon 共同創辦人 Sam Yam 來領導全新的「創作者產品」部門。在該創作者平臺服務超過 13 年後，他將帶著兩位 Patreon 高階主管一起加入。該團隊將為創作者打造全新工具，最快可能會在下週的 OpenAI 開發者大會（DevDay）上首次亮相。這篇題為 OpenAI 聘請 Patreon 共同創辦人 Sam Yam 領導全新創作者產品部門的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: 玉山AI轉型瞄準Agentic Banking，全面改造新一代AI代理平臺
items_all_raw.summary: 2026年的玉山銀行，並不是第一次發起AI轉型。他們曾用資料探勘發掘大數據裡的細節，也押寶預測型AI、大力發展上百支應用。但這次，他們思考的是——AI能不能不只給答案，還真正完成一段工作？ 這是玉山現階段想實現的代理式銀行（Agentic Banking）。玉山金控科技長張智星、玉山銀行智能金融處副總工程師廖子慧日前受訪時揭露，使用者只需告訴自家AI平臺要完成什麼任務，系統就會理解需求，再把任務交給相應的Agent執行；這套架構背後，則以記憶庫、Skill與工具目錄（Tool Registry）和MCP閘道，串起模型、知識庫、工具和內部系統，銜接一段段的工作流程。

items_all_raw.title: SF October 14th: A Birds of a Feather Session on Agentic Engineering
items_all_raw.summary: SF October 14th: A Birds of a Feather Session on Agentic Engineering I'm hosting an evening event with Jesse Vincent in San Francisco on Wednesday 14th October for people who are building weird and interesting things with and on top of coding agents. Think of it as an agentic show-and-tell: ​Compare notes with other builders and experimenters on things you’re trying, what you're learning, and what you haven’t figured out yet. We’re especially interested in work you haven’t discussed publicly, odd experiments, or unfinished projects that don’t have an obvious market. ​Expect one flowing conversation with an informal show-and-tell. Sharing something you’re working on is encouraged but no presentation is required. This isn't about product pitches, it's about much earlier explorations than that. This agentic AI stuff is weird! Let's celebrate and lean into that weirdness. Tags: events , ai , generative-ai , llms , coding-agents , jesse-vincent , agentic-engineering

items_all_raw.title: 火山引擎Seedance2.5上線Draft模式:480P試錯、1080P成片，成本最高省77%
items_all_raw.summary: 火山引擎爲Seedance2.5 API推出Draft樣片模式，將視頻生成分兩階段：先用480P低成本生成樣片，供創作者檢查場景、構圖、動作、對白音效與運鏡節奏，調整提示詞和素材後，再基於樣片ID生成1080P成片。模型關聯提示詞、參考素材及seed、比例、時長等參數二次推理，保證成片結構一致。

items_all_raw.summary: 美國總統川普（Donald Trump）本週二（9/22）在聯合國大會（United Nations General Assembly，UNGA）的General Debate上演講，直接表達美國反對任何以全球主義架構控制人工智慧（Artificial Intelligence，AI）的企圖，而且決定從此把「人工智慧」這個詞改為「超級智慧」（Super Intelligence，SI），因為「人工」（Artificial）這字讓智慧聽起來像是假的，可它並不是，還說希望全球跟進。

items_all_raw.title: AI 基建遭反噬：Q2 美國 680 億美元數據中心項目因公衆反對受阻
items_all_raw.summary: AI驅動數據中心建設在美國遇公衆強烈反對。研究顯示，今年二季度約680億美元項目延期或受阻，一季度達1300億，反對已覆蓋半數項目。Data Center Watch稱二季度共45個數據中心開發項目遭阻撓或延。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna：API 價格大降 50%，單任務成本最低不到競品一成
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI發佈GPT-6系列新成員Sol與Luna，採用與GPT-6 Astra相似的訓練方法，將Astra在專業工作、事實性、編碼、計算機使用和對齊等方面的頂尖性能帶入更快、更經濟的模型。OpenAI強調Astra仍是最強整體模型，追求無妥協體驗應首選。兩款API價格較GPT-5.6促銷價降低50%，成本最低不到競品一成。

items_all_raw.title: Anthropic上線Claude Opus 5.5 ，任務成本大降 40%
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic發佈Claude Opus 5.5，爲Claude 5.5系列首款。官方稱多數任務表現與Fable 5.1相當，成本較上代Opus 5降40%、速度提升超30%，9項測試中7項領先，編程表現突出。約兩小時後，OpenAI推出GPT-6 Sol和Luna，GPT-6“宇宙”擴容。
